attorneys.name: Daniel B. Greenstein
attorneys.practice_type: Homeowner Associations Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
There are not very many attorneys in the Minnesota legal community with the experience and common sense approach Dan utilizes in his practice. Dan has spent more than thirty years practicing law in the fields of real estate, banking, and general business matters. His practice also includes the negotiation, documentation and closing of complex financing, acquisition, development, leasing and sales transactions.

However, what Dan really loves is enabling directors of homeowner associations (common interest communities) to function properly and efficiently. He has worked in the area of homeowner association law and common interest community law (condominiums, townhomes and cooperatives) throughout his practice and developed a real niche in this area. Dan teaches and mentors homeowner association leadership. He spends much of every day reading, interpreting and writing homeowner association governing documents like articles of incorporation, declarations, bylaws, and rules and offering legal opinions to board members. His office has a fine tuned homeowner association assessment collection staff who understand that every dollar spent on collections is a dollar that is not available for other needs. Whether assisting a condominium board or perhaps a senior cooperative, Dan believes that he has handled most every kind of issue in his focused practice since 1982. He has probably already solved a problem just like yours.

Dan also is a frequent speaker at homeowner association law seminars. He enjoys offering seminars or board trainings for volunteer homeowner associations and knows how to focus on the issues that matter. He has taught too many different classes pertaining to Minnesota homeowner association law to mention, but he has the unique ability to explain complicated legal issues in a way that everyone can understand. He is often a guest speaker at Minnesota common interest community and cooperative industry functions, where he consistently gets excellent reviews.

Dan loves to sail, golf and ride his Harley during the summer months. He has been known to show up to homeowner association annual meetings on his Harley.

sections.content:
There are not very many attorneys in the Minnesota legal community with the experience and common sense approach Dan utilizes in his practice. Dan has spent more than thirty years practicing law in the fields of real estate, banking, and general business matters. His practice also includes the negotiation, documentation and closing of complex financing, acquisition, development, leasing and sales transactions.

However, what Dan really loves is enabling directors of homeowner associations (common interest communities) to function properly and efficiently. He has worked in the area of homeowner association law and common interest community law (condominiums, townhomes and cooperatives) throughout his practice and developed a real niche in this area. Dan teaches and mentors homeowner association leadership. He spends much of every day reading, interpreting and writing homeowner association governing documents like articles of incorporation, declarations, bylaws, and rules and offering legal opinions to board members. His office has a fine tuned homeowner association assessment collection staff who understand that every dollar spent on collections is a dollar that is not available for other needs. Whether assisting a condominium board or perhaps a senior cooperative, Dan believes that he has handled most every kind of issue in his focused practice since 1982. He has probably already solved a problem just like yours.

Dan also is a frequent speaker at homeowner association law seminars. He enjoys offering seminars or board trainings for volunteer homeowner associations and knows how to focus on the issues that matter. He has taught too many different classes pertaining to Minnesota homeowner association law to mention, but he has the unique ability to explain complicated legal issues in a way that everyone can understand. He is often a guest speaker at Minnesota common interest community and cooperative industry functions, where he consistently gets excellent reviews.

Dan loves to sail, golf and ride his Harley during the summer months. He has been known to show up to homeowner association annual meetings on his Harley.

attorneys.name: Matthew Greenstein
attorneys.practice_type: Homeowner Associations Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Matt is a founding partner of Greenstein Sellers. His practice is focused on real estate law, creditors' remedies, general business law, and civil litigation. His clients range from individuals and small business owners to construction companies, real estate developers, and nonprofit organizations. A majority of his practice is dedicated to homeowner association law where he is involved in the representation of over 400 homeowner associations throughout Minnesota.

Matt takes pride in understanding the needs of his clients and providing individualized counsel to achieve his clients' goals. Matt provides effective counsel during all stages of representation. Whether helping clients start a business, negotiating a contract, or providing courtroom representation, Matt is a zealous advocate for his clients.

As a lifelong resident of Minnesota, Matt is involved in many community and charitable organizations. In the legal community, Matt is a frequent speaker at legal continuing education courses and has provided lectures for the Hennepin County Bar Association on several occasions.

Matt currently serves on the board of directors for the Minnesota Multi-Housing Association and on several committees for CIC Midwest, an organization focused on education and services for common interest communities.

When away from work, Matt enjoys the art and science of perfecting barbeque, playing golf, and spending time with his wife.

attorneys.name: Kevin Gregorius
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Honesty, knowledge and dedication are invaluable attributes of an attorney. These are the qualities I have provided to my clients since I started practicing at Meshbesher & Associates 13 years ago. Success in the criminal field is often a matter of degree. If your lawyer doesn’t understand the law, won’t put in the time and effort to prepare your case for a defense or can’t be candid with you in the course of the relationship – you’ve probably chosen the wrong person to represent you.

I am originally from Lincoln, Nebraska. I earned a Bachelor of Journalism degree from the University of Nebraska, Lincoln, with minors in philosophy, history and political science. In my off-time I coached and judged high school policy debate. I graduated in 1998, moved to Minnesota and started work at Allina Health Systems as their Conference Center Coordinator. I was accepted by William Mitchell College of Law in 2000, began working as a law clerk for Meshbesher & Associates in 2001 and graduated with my JD in 2003. I have been practicing here ever since.

Since joining this firm as an associate, I have handled and assisted hundreds of criminal cases across the entire spectrum of the law – from traffic tickets to homicides in state and federal court – in Minnesota, Wisconsin, South Dakota, Iowa and Kansas at the trial court and appellate court levels. If you are in trouble and would like to speak with me about your case, I am happy to talk with you.

attorneys.name: Andy Gregory
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Eden Prairie, MN
attorneys.bio:
Andy has been passionate about the law for many years. During an extended career with the federal government, he began pursuing his dream of becoming a practicing attorney. Andy graduated cum laude from Mitchell Hamline School of Law in Saint Paul, Minnesota, and served as an Associate on the Mitchell Hamline Law Review. He earned his bachelor's degree in business finance from Liberty University in Lynchburg, Virginia.

Andy’s practice consists primarily of Estate Planning, Estate Administration, Wills and Trusts, and Conservatorships/Guardianships. In his estate planning, he works with individuals, couples and families to develop comprehensive and efficient estate plans through wills, trusts, incapacity instruments and other related documents. Andy also works with those suffering from the loss of a loved one to smoothly and cost-effectively navigate the administration of an estate through the probate system or by providing counsel to trustees.

Additionally, his experience provides him with insights into the financial decisions, social work and life care plans associated with guardianships and conservatorships. This background informs his personalized service and compassionate approach to family legal matters. Andy is professional yet approachable and is full of positive energy when it comes to helping his clients.

In his free time, Andy enjoys spending time with his wife, Jessica, and their cats, Watkins & Enders, at their home in Minneapolis. They enjoy running, bike rides, and traveling.

attorneys.name: Christa J. Groshek
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Since the year 2000, Christa Groshek has litigated cases before judges and juries in Minnesota and nationally. Christa often defends charges of criminal sexual conduct, child pornography possession / dissemination and production, child abuse and murder. Christa also regularly collaborates and consults with experts in child abuse cases - especially where allegations of "Shaken Baby Syndrome" or "Abusive Head Trauma" are brought. She also regularly works with experts in criminal sexual conduct cases who can opine about memory evidence and the proper collection of it, including the particulars of the forensic interviewing protocol.

In 2018, Christa developed a new way to practice by devoting three attorneys to every case. The "Groshek Method" of thoroughly investigating and rigorously defending cases is enjoyed by the firm's criminal, child protection, maltreatment, licensing, appeals and family clients.

Intense onboarding, consistent mentoring and ongoing training are also cornerstones of the "Groshek Method." Seven attorneys and five support staff offer Groshek Law clients professional and prompt service. Christa oversees the firm and guarantees that everyone at the firm delivers professional, prepared and proactive services to every client.

In addition to training Groshek Law staff, Christa has also authored a chapter on the complexities of representing juveniles in criminal court. Frequently, she is invited to provide legal commentary on local and national cases. She has been featured on Twin Cities media outlets as well as Bloomberg Law. Several of Christa's clients have garnered national media attention and the firm often choses to engage the media in an effort to ensure due process for its clients. Currently, a London documentary company is creating a short film about one of Groshek Law's most notable cases.

In 2000, Christa Groshek graduated Cum Laude from William Mitchell College of Law. During law school, Christa was a law clerk for the Washington County Public Defender's Office where she received her first criminal defense experience. Christa later took a position as the law clerk for the Honorable Thomas Armstrong in Stillwater, Minnesota. There, she worked in civil law, doing legal research and drafting orders.

Christa took her first attorney position at the Legal Rights Center in Minneapolis; she practiced criminal defense in Juvenile Court. After approximately one year, Christa joined the Hennepin County Public Defender's Office in downtown Minneapolis. Continuing in Juvenile Court she worked on Delinquencies and represented families in Child Protection cases.

After a total of three years experience in Juvenile Court, Christa transferred to the Adult Felony Trial Team. On the Trial Team, Christa handled many cases ranging from DWIs to Murder. In Christa's first year on the Trial Team, she handled more trials in one year than some private defense attorneys have in ten years. Significantly, 80% of those trials resulted in NOT GUILTY jury verdicts. Since that time, Ms. Groshek has handled thousands of cases with outstanding results; She has tried over 50 cases to juries.

Groshek Law is located in its own exclusive building in North Loop neighborhood in downtown Minneapolis. The firm is attached to a parking garage for convenience. We look forward to seeing you soon!

attorneys.practice_type: Family Lawyers in Maple Grove, MN
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Gunderson has represented individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations for over 30 years. He has experience in a broad range of civil litigation, including mechanic’s liens and other construction litigation, contract disputes, real estate matters, personal injury defense, and contested probate and trust proceedings. Elder law matters, including guardianship and conservatorship proceedings is another area that Mr. Gunderson has an extensive background in.

Working extensively in all aspects of family law, including divorce, child custody, paternity, complex property division, family business issues, protection of nonmarital assets, spousal maintenance, grandparent custody, and antenuptial agreements, Mr. Gunderson has year of experience helping his clients resolve their disputes quickly. He will ensure that his client’s interests are protected throughout the process, from drafting and responding to claims and petitions, providing guidance through mediation, settlement agreements, and, if necessary, contested court trials and appeals.

Mr. Gunderson is admitted to practice law in all courts in the State of Minnesota, including the United States District Court for Minnesota and the United States Eighth Circuit Court of Appeals. He is a member of the Minnesota State Bar Association and the Ramsey County Bar Association. He is a graduate of the College of St. Thomas (University of St. Thomas) in St. Paul, MN, and William Mitchell College of Law (Mitchell Hamline School of Law) in St. Paul, MN. He lives in St. Paul.

attorneys.name: Jeffery S. Haff
attorneys.practice_type: Franchise Law Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Jeffery S. Haff is a partner at Dady & Gardner. In his over 30 years of practice, Jeff has represented franchisees, dealers and distributors throughout the United States. For the year 2017, Best Lawyers in America named him “Lawyer of the Year” for Minneapolis franchise lawyers. Over the course of his career, Jeff has been honored to receive numerous accolades including:

Being named every year since 2010 as one of the “Best Lawyers in America” in the field of Franchise Law.

Being named a Minnesota “Super Lawyer” every year since 2002.

Being named a “Legal Eagle” by Franchise Times on multiple occasions.

Being ranked as an “AV Preeminent” lawyer for 20 years and recently receiving the prestigious “AV Preeminent Judicial Edition” award from Martindale-Hubbell.

Over his career, Jeff has achieved millions of dollars of settlements and awards for wronged dealers, distributors and franchisees, including arbitration awards in the hundreds of thousands of dollars for wrongfully terminated Polaris dealers and defrauded Sir Speedy franchisees. Some of Jeff’s reported cases include:

Jeff successfully argued to the Iowa Court of Appeals the case of FECO, Ltd. v. Highway Equipment Co., Inc., 2010 WL 5394727 (Iowa App. Dec. 22, 2010). This case establishes, contrary to the trial court’s ruling and also contrary to one previous decision by an Iowa federal court, that Chapter 322F of Iowa Code (the Iowa Dealer Act) does permit a wrongfully terminated equipment dealer to sue and recover money damages for the wrongful termination. The manufacturer of agricultural equipment had argued that a dealer’s only remedy for wrongful termination under the Iowa Dealer Act was an injunction against termination.

On November 2, 2016, Jeff, along with South Dakota counsel David Edwards, received a favorable jury verdict for a terminated Isuzu Truck dealer in the case SIOUX FALLS KENWORTH, INC. d/b/a ISUZU TRUCKS OF SIOUX FALLS v. ISUZU COMMERCIAL TRUCK OF AMERICA, INC., Civil Case No. 14-cv-04187(RAL) (D.S.D. 2016). The South Dakota jury awarded $1.676 million against the Defendant, who was represented at trial by two of the most prominent defense firms in the nation. The amount of damages was remitted to $1,033,756.48 on August 18, 2017 – see Sioux Falls Kenworth, Inc. v. Isuzu Commercial Trucks of America, Inc., 2017 WL 3600404 (D.S.D. August 18, 2017) (the court also added $802,246.04 in attorneys’ fees and costs to the reduced judgment, resulting in a total judgment of $1,836,223.52).

In November of 2019, Jeff and Serena Chiquoine obtained an $890,000 arbitration award based upon statutory and common law fraud claims against the 18|8 franchise system franchisor and two of its control persons. After adding attorneys’ fees and pre-award interest, the final Award was roughly $1,400,000.

On May 20, 2022, Jeff, along with his colleagues, won a very important ruling in the case of Expedition League, Inc. v. Badlands Big Sticks Baseball Club, LLC et al., South Dakota Circuit Court Case No.: 51Civ22-150, defeating a 3-year 100-mile non-compete claim and the possibility of over $5,000,000 in liquidated damages against owners of a summer baseball league. Circuit Court Judge Stacy Wickre dismissed the non-compete claims, accepting the argument of Jeff and his co-counsel that non-competes of this sort are void under SDCL 53-9-8 and case law of the South Dakota courts. The Plaintiff in the case, the Expedition League, had hoped to put the owners out of business and deny the people of the Upper Midwest summer baseball for 2022-2024. Jeff is very proud to have solidified the law in South Dakota on non-competes and to have been able to help the public see summer baseball in these trying times.

Jeff was one of 20 Presidential Honors Scholars in his graduating class at the State University of New York at Buffalo (B.A. summa cum laude 1986). Jeff graduated from the prestigious Duke University School of Law (J.D. With Honors 1989). Jeff lives in Maple Grove, Minnesota with his wife Carol. They have three grown children: Kelly (born 1994), Ryan (1995) and Erica (1998).

attorneys.name: Thomas K. Hagen
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Mankato, MN
attorneys.bio:
As a partner at Kohlmeyer Hagen law Office Chtd., located in Mankato, Minnesota, Thomas Hagen has built an exceptional legal practice centered on personal service and unwavering attention to detail. With offices not only in Mankato but also in Rochester, MN, Tom has extended his reach and expertise throughout southern Minnesota.

With a specialization exclusively in criminal defense, Mr. Hagen has consistently delivered outstanding results for his clients. Over the years, he has successfully defended individuals facing a broad spectrum of legal challenges, from allegations of sexual assault, DUI, and DWI, to complex drug crime cases, serious felonies, and murder. His dedication to protecting the rights and interests of those he represents has earned him a sterling reputation in the legal community.

Tom's accomplishments and contributions to the field have not gone unnoticed. His recognition as a Rising Star by Minneapolis-St. Paul Magazine for an impressive decade, from 2012 to 2021, is a testament to his enduring excellence. This prestigious award, limited to no more than 2.5% of lawyers under the age of 40 in the State of Minnesota, reflects his exceptional legal skills and unwavering commitment to justice. He was also named a Super Lawyer in 2023, and Minnesota Attorneys of the Year.

Tom is an active member of numerous professional associations, including the American Bar Association, Minnesota State Bar, and Minnesota Association for Justice. His involvement in these organizations underscores his dedication to staying at the forefront of legal developments and maintaining the highest ethical standards in his practice.

Having handled a multitude of high-profile cases, Tom's legal expertise has garnered the attention of major media outlets. He has been interviewed by the New York Times, USA Today, NBC Dateline, and the Minneapolis Star Tribune, where he has provided insights on complex legal matters and showcased his deep understanding of the law.

His exceptional accomplishments extend to his recognition as a member of the National Trial Lawyers: Top 100, a distinction reserved for the most accomplished trial attorneys in the country. Furthermore, Tom has consistently received the highest rating allowed by Avvo.com, a leading legal directory, and has been honored with the prestigious Client Choice Award, reflecting his dedication to client satisfaction and outstanding legal representation.

Notably, on May 4, 2021, Tom received the highest honor as he was awarded the National Trial Lawyer of the Year from The National Trial Lawyers Association. This prestigious accolade solidifies his position as a legal luminary and a beacon of excellence in the legal profession.

attorneys.name: Richard M. Hagstrom
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Rick handles a variety of complex litigation matters in state and federal courts across the country. These matters, primarily in the areas of antitrust, financial institutions, insurance coverage, commercial and securities litigation, involve high dollar exposure, and often multiple parties.

In the antitrust arena, Rick has defended and prosecuted numerous antitrust actions. He has been co-lead counsel in the only two indirect purchaser antitrust lawsuits against Microsoft Corporation that went to trial. In 2004, after seven weeks of trial, Rick reached a $182 million settlement with Microsoft Corporation on behalf of Minnesota businesses and consumers. In November 2006, Rick was co-lead counsel in another class action trial against Microsoft in Des Moines, Iowa, which settled in February 2007 for $180 million. Rick also led a third consumer class action against Microsoft in Wisconsin, which settled in 2007 for $224 million.

In the insurance coverage arena, Rick has been national litigation counsel for environmental claims for a major property and casualty insurer. Rick has successfully handled dozens of multi-party and class action cases for his insurer clients involving environmental, product, mass tort, and bad faith claims, as well as McCarran-Ferguson Act issues. In addition, Rick has advised insurers on regulatory matters.

In the commercial arena, Rick has represented both plaintiffs and defendants in banking, RICO, unfair trade practices, securities, securities lending, and intellectual property litigation.

Rick has been named a Minnesota Attorney of the Year. Rick is on the Board and the Vice-Chair of the Fund for the Legal Aid Society. Rick also serves on the Board of Trustees for the S.J. Quinney College of Law, University of Utah.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Marsh is a founding partner of Halberg Criminal Defense - Minnesota's largest and most experienced criminal defense law firm.

Marsh has spent the past 37 years focusing on criminal law - acting as both a prosecutor and defense attorney. He has handled some of the most notable cases in the State of Minnesota. Marsh has tried well over 100 criminal jury trials and literally thousands of criminal court trials. He has garnered extensive experience in both state and federal court handling all types of criminal litigation, including homicide, criminal sexual conduct, drug offenses, complex white collar crimes, vehicular injury and DWI cases.

It is of value for a defense attorney to know how the other side thinks. As a former Chief Prosecutor for the City of Edina and the Metropolitan Airports Commission (MAC), Marsh supervised the prosecution of over 15,000 criminal cases annually. Marsh has also previously served as an Assistant Carver County Attorney in Chaska, Minnesota.

Marsh is one of Minnesota’s most requested Continuing Legal Education speaker on criminal law issues. He is the author of numerous training manuals and criminal law seminar materials. Notably, Marsh is the editor-in-chief of The Minnesota DWI Deskbook, the most comprehensive DWI source book for attorneys in Minnesota. Marsh also assists in the training of newly appointed Minnesota District Court Judges.

attorneys.name: Hilary R. Hannon
attorneys.practice_type: Property Subrogation Lawyers in St Cloud, MN
attorneys.bio:
Paralegal: Amber Guck amber@rgp.law

Hilary R. Hannon comes to RGP with the merger of RGP and Pfefferle Kane LLP in January 2025. Hilary began working in civil litigation as an associate with Pfefferle Kane in 2022. Prior to that Hilary was a prosecutor in Hennepin County, Minnesota, handling felony criminal matters involving drugs, guns, burglary, criminal sexual conduct, child abuse, assault, and murder. She is an experienced trial lawyer; between 2018 and 2022, Hilary tried twenty-one jury trials and six court trials to verdict. Hilary started her career as a judicial clerk for the Honorable Judge Sara Grewing in Ramsey County, Minnesota, where Judge Grewing presided over family and juvenile court matters. During law school Hilary worked as a law clerk and Certified Student Attorney at the Hennepin County Attorney’s Office.

Hilary's practice areas include subrogation, construction design and defect matters, insurance defense, and first-party insurance coverage issues, including appraisals. While with Pfefferle Kane her work focused primarily on fire, fire protection failure, and construction defect losses. Her prior criminal trial experience has helpfully informed her work involving deposition testimony, motion practice, oral argument, and settlement negotiations.

Hilary grew up in Stillwater, Minnesota and now lives in Saint Paul with her husband and three children. She is an avid reader and sports fan, and loves to spend time outdoors camping, hiking, and boating.

attorneys.name: Erik F. Hansen
attorneys.practice_type: Appellate Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Erik Hansen is the managing partner at Burns and Hansen, focusing on complex civil litigation, appeals, and business transactions.

Erik has over twenty years of experience litigating multi-million dollar, high-stakes complex civil litigation cases in state and federal court in Minnesota and across the country. Erik has successfully argued cases at every level of state court in Minnesota, as well as in multiple federal jurisdictions, both at the district and appellate court levels. Erik has received national awards and recognition for his advocacy on behalf of clients.

Erik is an established voice in the Minnesota appellate practice community. He brings a broad range of experience to his appellate practice, handling a variety of cases including commercial matters, civil appeals, and civil litigation issues. He has argued over eighty cases before state and federal appellate courts. Erik has served as the Chair of the Minnesota State Bar Association Appellate Law Section from 2014 to 2015. The Minnesota Supreme Court appointed Erik to an Advisory Committee on Rules of Civil Appellate Procedure on which he served for a decade. Erik is a frequent speaker for appellate continued legal education courses.

Erik routinely advises corporations and business as they grow and acquire multi-million dollar assets and real property. He assists businesses as they navigate complex regulatory and compliance issues, as well as addresses business disputes between owners. Erik works with business owners to mitigate risk and transition companies to new ownership. Erik has also assisted companies in registering and acquiring copyrights and trademarks, as well as litigated cases involving such intellectual property.

Known for his concise and direct style of advocacy, Erik provides prudent and candid advice to his clients at all levels of the legal system. Erik can identify the key issues in a case, determine a path forward, and either litigate or negotiate as necessary to reach his clients' goals.

Erik has been named a Super Lawyer or a Rising Star each year since 2006. In 2006, Erik was named as an Up & Coming Attorney by Minnesota Lawyer. In 2016, Erik was named as Attorney of the Year by Minnesota Lawyer. Erik has also been named a Senior Fellow, Litigation Counsel of America.

Erik is a graduate of the University of Minnesota Law School and the University of Minnesota-Morris, where he majored in Political Science and European Studies. Erik received his law degree from the University of Minnesota.

In addition to his legal work, Erik volunteers in the community. Erik currently serves on the Rethos Board as the Main Street Committee Chair, where he advises on efforts to preserve historic buildings. Erik also serves on the Mitchell Lake Association Board.

In his spare time, Erik coaches youth soccer, spends time with his friends and family, and enjoys travel and hiking.

He brings an entrepreneurial spirit to his practice that is reflected in the clients that he represents.

Tom's focus has been on business, real estate and construction law. He serves as counselor to a variety of small to medium-size businesses advising them on all aspects of business law from formation and capitalization of entities, to consulting and negotiating various contracts, leases, and other agreements, and finally representing these clients and their needs in federal and state courts across the country. sections.content:
Biographical Notes: Tom is one of the founding shareholders of Madigan, Dahl & Harlan, P.A. and except for a short hiatus with a startup real estate/tax lien acquisition, holding and servicing company, he has practiced law since 1991. He brings an entrepreneurial spirit to his practice that is reflected in the clients that he represents.

Tom's focus has been on business, real estate and construction law. He serves as counselor to a variety of small to medium-size businesses advising them on all aspects of business law from formation and capitalization of entities, to consulting and negotiating various contracts, leases, and other agreements, and finally representing these clients and their needs in federal and state courts across the country. He has advised clients on all forms of corporate transactions, financing, and land use issues Tom has served as an expert testifying about various aspects of real estate and corporate law.

Representative Work

Real Estate:

Represented manufacturing company in the sale of its $7.8 million dollar facility.

Represented group of investors in a $9 million dollar roll-up of their tenant-in common interests into a new entity which has continued ownership interest in the property.

Represented clients in an asset sale transaction that involved 52 separate real estate locations.

Served as counsel for a $900 million transaction involving the purchase of chain of restaurants.

Represented clients in a $25 million loan restructuring secured by various assets including three separate parcels of real estate.

Represented client in a purchase of a $2.0 million dollar distressed office building.

Represented client in negotiating 38 separate easement agreements to create sufficient space for a 35 Megawatt wind farm.

Represented client in negotiating a lease with Texas municipality and easement rights over various gas and oil interests.

Worked on all aspects of the purchase, sale, redemption, and foreclosure of tax liens in a $45 million dollar portfolio.

Mergers and Acquisitions/License

Represented client in an $8 million dollar sale of i-phone app.

Represented client in the merger of its medical software business and a capital raise of $10 million dollars to support the continued development of its products.

Represented client in a $3.2 million dollar sale of its internet hosting business.

Represented clients in a $2.6 million dollar asset sale of its marketing/lead origination business.

Represented client in the $3.3 million dollar sale of its aircraft software business.

Represented client in the establishment of distribution agreements in South Korea, Italy, and Azerbaijan.

Represented numerous clients in the sale of their business to private investor groups including transactions in the amount of $52 million, $15 million and $46 million.

Represented a client in the roll out of over 300 separate franchises across 30 states.

Represented numerous beer distributors across the country, as the seller or buyer, in asset and stock transactions (including real estate for operations).

Litigation

Represented five different clients in foreclosing upon over 30 parcels of land in satisfaction of their mechanic's liens.

Successfully represented numerous clients in the enforcement of employment non-compete agreements in the States of California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon and Washington.

Successfully represented numerous clients in the enforcement of a noncompete related to the sale of a business in California, Minnesota, Oregon, Washington and Wisconsin.

Successfully represented a client in a fraudulent transfer of real property valued at $1.1 million dollars resulting in a forfeiture of the property.

Successfully represented a client by challenging the fraudulent transfer of real property valued at $1.5 million dollars among family members.

Successfully represented various lenders on the foreclosure of real property and other assets used to secure financial instruments.

Successfully represented numerous shareholders in disputes involving their interests in corporations and limited liability companies.

Energy

Successfully represented numerous clients in wind project developments including but not limited to the negotiation of land use agreements, easements, turbine supply agreements, power purchase agreements, and engineering, procurement, and construction agreements.

Successfully represented a city and county in opposing an upgrade of existing power lines that ran through the city and the county.

Successfully represented a client in negotiating a power purchase agreement for electricity generated by gas from an anaerobic digester.

Represented a client in opposing a license to a nuclear power plant allowing it to store spent fuel resulting from its continued operations.

Represented a city in opposition to a power uprate for a nuclear power plant and an extension of its license for the storage of spent fuel resulting from the plant's continued operation.

attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Jack is a Shareholder, Director, and the head of the Messerli & Kramer P.A. Business Litigation Department. He has been practicing law since 1977. Prior to joining Messerli & Kramer P.A., Jack was a shareholder at Krass Monroe, P.A., head of its business litigation department, and its President/CEO. Jack specializes in complex business litigation, including shareholder, contract, director and officer liability, fraud, and life, health and disability cases. Jack is regularly retained to represent clients in cases around the country, has earned a reputation as a zealous advocate, and is annually selected as a "Super Lawyer" by his peers. Recently, Jack was recognized as a 2011 "Attorney of the Year" by Minnesota Lawyer (Read More). He has obtained defense verdicts and decisions in numerous multi-million dollar cases and has obtained million dollar awards and settlements for his clients, including a recent $1,919,000 arbitration award in Illinois on behalf of a boat warranty company in a breach of contract and unjust enrichment action in March, 2011.

Jack has represented life, health, and disability carriers since 1982 and a significant portion of his practice involves defending officers and directors in breach of fiduciary duty and fraud litigation and representing business owners in shareholder/member/partner disputes.

Jack is licensed in the state, federal, and appellate courts of Minnesota and Wisconsin, the federal courts of North Dakota and Nebraska, and the United States Supreme Court. He has represented clients in cases in more than 25 states.

attorneys.name: Brooks M. Hazelton
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Bemidji, MN
attorneys.bio:
I was raised in Bemidji, Minnesota. In 2011, I married my wife Lauren from Anchorage, Alaska. In 2013 I joined my dad’s law practice but hung my own shingle in the 49th state. We lived full-time in Alaska until 2017, when we had our first child. Then we returned to Bemidji to raise our kids. We now have three. Lauren is an optometrist and owns the only locally owned eye clinic in Bemidji. White Spruce Optometry.

My passions include my family, and like many northern Minnesotans and Alaskans, I love to hunt, fish, and play outside. Fortunately, my job is also a passion. My job is to advocate for the injured and the families of those who are wrongfully killed. In my daily practice, I work across from defense lawyers and insurance adjusters. The fire lit inside of me early in my career. In 2015, I represented a woman in Alaska. It was an injury claim that all the other lawyers she spoke with rejected. My client’s significant medical condition resulted from a relatively low speed rear-end collision. She had been representing herself, her husband had left her, and I couldn’t say no. State Farm Insurance Company was our opponent. Unwilling to be fair, they offered $6,000 of go-away money to settle my client’s claim. I spent a year working on the case headed for a trial. My dad flew to Alaska, and we tried the case for three weeks to an Anchorage jury. When we were done, my dad flew home to Bemidji before the jury verdict came. We were called to the courtroom for the verdict, and it totaled $620,526. My client collapsed into my arms in tears of joy. It wasn’t about the money; it was that she was heard, and she was believed.

From that day forward, I knew I was doing exactly what I was put on this earth to do. And I was energized to be the best at it. Aside from the trial skills, I enjoy getting to know my clients. We often have a very personal relationship as I help them navigate, likely one of the worst experiences of their life. I take that job seriously and enjoy finding the right strategy for each client to maximize their recovery while maintaining their quality of life and mitigating their risk. I can often settle my client’s case for a fair amount of money without stepping into a courtroom. But if we need to go there, we are prepared, and the insurance industry knows that.

I am licensed in Minnesota and Alaska. My practice has been limited to personal injury and wrongful death claims for over a decade. I emphasize wrongful death because, for many in my field, they are some of the most challenging claims to present effectively and to resolve fairly. But I can because my focus is on relationship loss and the presentation of that loss. I have represented parents who have lost their young children and adults who have lost their elderly parents. And sadly, many other relationships between. Not one is the same, and I handle each to their unique circumstances.

Recently, I have expanded my practice. Over the years, I have recognized the value of civility and professionalism in the legal process. There are usually good people represented by hard-working and caring advocates on both sides of a dispute. Although most of my practice continues to be as an advocate for plaintiffs. I believe in the alternative dispute resolution (ADR) system, and my experience in both trial and ADR has led me down the path to becoming a qualified neutral on the Minnesota Supreme Court’s civil mediation roster. Alternative dispute resolutions, like mediation, often provide significant benefits in these emotionally charged and financially taxing cases. I am mutually selected as a mediator. When I am hired as a mediator, I carefully prepare for each mediation by reviewing case details and listening to all parties, working towards settlements that meet their needs.

attorneys.name: Douglas V. Hazelton
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Bemidji, MN
attorneys.bio:
A partner with Halberg Criminal Defense, Minnesota's largest and most experienced criminal defense law firm, Doug has practiced for over 20 years exclusively in the area of criminal defense, concentrating on DWI/DUI defense. He has successfully handled hundreds of criminal cases, including assault, theft, sex crimes, drug offenses and homicide throughout Minnesota and Wisconsin.

After graduating from Antioch College in Ohio, Doug received his law degree from William Mitchell College of Law. Since 1997 he has regularly attended and instructed at the National College of DUI Defense conducted at Harvard Law School. Doug is one of two Minnesota attorneys to graduate the Borkenstein Course conducted at Indiana University, which teaches the forensics of alcohol testing to law enforcement. He is a certified Intoxilyzer and DataMaster operator and trained in Standardized Field Sobriety Testing.

Doug frequently lectures on DUI/DWI-related topics, both in Minnesota and throught the country. His articles have appeared in Criminal Defense Techniques, Criminal Constitutional Law, the Hennepin Lawyer and in 2008 he wrote the Minnesota DWI Law Handbook, which is currently in its ninth printing. He has also co-authored the Minnesota DUI Survival Guide: A Citizen's Protection Manual.

attorneys.name: Gary M. Hazelton
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Bemidji, MN
attorneys.bio:
I was born in Jamestown, North Dakota, where my dad grew up. We moved to a suburb of Minneapolis in 1962 when I was 5. My dad was a blue-collar tradesman who could do anything from build large commercial buildings to fine furniture to rebuild engines. So I grew up around that stuff. We bought a fishing resort in the fall of 1972 and moved to Northern Minnesota. Hard work and long days in season but we met so many people from the 5-state area who stayed at the resort and became long-term friends. I graduated from Bemidji High School in 1976 and went to college only to play football. No plan for what I wanted to do. A fellow defensive back told me to go into Industrial Education because "you get to work on all the machines" - so that is what I did. The student teaching experience left me second guessing a teaching career. Got married in 1979 after playing in the homecoming game. My wife was headed into teaching. An uncle, who was a lawyer, was back to my parent's resort and after discussing my lack of desire to teach he told me to go to law school and he would give me a job. So, by mere happenstance I went to law school, graduating from the University of North Dakota School of Law in 1985. My wife Diane and I raised our 4 children in the Bemidji area. Diane retired from teaching about 6 years ago and spends much time with our 6 grandchildren. We have just completed a new home on a lovely chain of lakes and love lake living. In October 2000 I attended Gerry Spence's Trial Lawyers College (famed Wyoming trial attorney), am past president of the Minnesota Association of Justice and frequent presenter on and have written extensively on all aspects of trial skills. For about 10 years I have studied significantly in the field of neuro-linguistics and neuro-semantics and breaking down every aspect of trial practice from presence to story structure to semantic use of space in the courtroom. My practice is limited to personal injury with much emphasis on product liability. I am licensed in Minnesota, North Dakota, Alaska, Red Lake Nation and Leech Lake tribal courts.

The relationship you form with your lawyer is the difference that makes a difference. The insurance adjusters sense the difference, and the jurors see the difference. When we know your story we can tell your story in a way that the felt sense is that of a lived experience. That is what it motivates the adjuster or jurors to act make it right. That is true justice.

I have helped families from many different walks of life throughout southern Minnesota. No two cases are the same, so it's important to clearly understand your concerns. I can then help you come up with creative solutions to your unique needs. I was born and raised in Minnesota and I truly value the community around me.

From walking you through the process of negotiation or litigation in court, I am here to be your strongest advocate. Family law cases can be emotional and time-consuming. I'm here to help you fight for the best possible solution. In addition to my legal advocacy as an attorney, I also have 10 years of experience serving as a neutral mediator. I can serve as a neutral in your mediation process. Whether it is dealing with divorce proceedings, determining child custody or dividing your property, I have the experience you need to move forward.

attorneys.name: Kirstin E. Helmers
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Disputes Lawyers in St. Paul, MN
attorneys.bio:
Throughout her practice, Kirstin Helmers has focused exclusively on probate and trust litigation. Inheritance disputes often involve high-tension, high stress situations. Kirstin utilizes a firm, creative and thoughtful approach to help clients navigate these emotionally charged situations and achieve optimal results in court, at mediation or in informal negotiations.

Kirstin also writes and teaches about probate and trust litigation and helps plan the annual Minnesota Probate, Trusts and Estates Section Conference. She was the Chair of the Minnesota State Bar Association Probate, Trust and Estates Section for 2024-2025 and was Co-Chair of the Section’s Litigation and Dispute Resolution Committee from 2018-2023.

Kirstin graduated from Columbia University with a degree in Russian History and obtained her law degree from the University of Minnesota. In law school, she clerked at the Hennepin County Attorney's Office, taught legal writing, and was the head writer for the Theatre of the Relatively Talentless, the law school's annual musical. Since law school, Kirstin has enjoyed spending time in court, first as a law clerk for Hennepin County Judge Marilyn Rosenbaum (ret.), then as an associate with Rodney J. Mason, Ltd., and now at Mason & Helmers.

He has assisted small businesses in various legal areas, including company formation, shareholder agreements, member agreements, sales, purchases, dissolution, construction, real estate, as well as employment agreements, independent contractor agreements, and non-compete agreements and disputes. He has represented clients in mediations, arbitrations, motions and trials.

Mr. Hendrikson has extensive experience in real estate matters. He has helped numerous clients with drafting and reviewing due dilligence, letters of intent, purchase agreements, lease agreements and closing transactions. Deed preparation and record maintenance are to additional areas he can assist with when it comes to real estate law. Mr. Hendrikson looks to ensures that all terms are legally binding and the interests of his clients are protected and informed. Clients have worked with him for his advisory services regarding title examination, real estate investments, property boundary issues, breach of contract, and landlord-tenant disagreements, often through negotiation or litigation.

Mr. Hendrikson is proud to be an attorney with Donohue McKenney and has teamed with colleague Chad McKenney for over 25 years on complex motions, trials and appeals. He attended college at Brown University in Providence, RI before transferring and obtaining his B.A. in Management from Gustavus Adolphus College in St. Peter, MN. He got his J.D, cum laude, from William Mitchell College of Law in St. Paul, MN . Mr. Hendrikson has helped write and teach legal classes on various subjects involving real estate and limited liability companies. He enjoys serving his family and community, coaching youth hockey and still occasionally tries to contribute as a player on the Hennepin County lawyers hockey team in the annual Barristers Cup tournament when they travel to face their friendly foes from Thunder Bay north of the border.

attorneys.name: Norma B. Henning
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration and Mobility Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Norma Brenne Henning has extensive experience assisting companies, families, investors, employers and entrepreneurs in facilitating travel and establishing U.S. residency, presence and work authorization for family members, executives and employees. She represents her clients in petitions to the United States Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS), applications for immigrant and non-immigrant visas before U.S. Consulates worldwide, and Customs and Border Protection (CBP).

As a Florida Civil Law Notary with a deep understanding of legal frameworks in code-based jurisdictions, she also assists foreign families, individuals and investors in navigating complex residential real estate investment transactions.

Families look to her to devise ways in which their non-U.S. family members can smoothly visit or permanently join them in the United States while complying with the various requirements of U.S. immigration law. In the business immigration context, she assists her clients in obtaining the proper visas or status to accomplish their business objectives in the most effective way possible primarily focusing on immigrant and non-immigrant visas for Investors (E Visas, EB-5 Green Cards), Intra-company transfers (L Visas and EB-1 Green Cards), and Aliens of Extraordinary Ability (O visas and EB-1 Green Cards). Finally, she assists clients in their final steps of their American journey, their applications for naturalization and citizenship.

She holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Florida College of Law and a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism from Troy University in Alabama. She was admitted to the Florida Bar in 1996, became a Florida Civil Law Notary in 2002 and was admitted to the Minnesota Bar in 2022. She is a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association (AILA), the Florida and Minnesota Bars, and the Collier County (Florida) Bar Association.

In 2003, she was appointed by the German State Department (Foreign Office of the Federal Republic of Germany) as the Honorary Consul of Germany for Western Florida. In this capacity, she supported the German Consulate General in Miami in diplomatic and administrative matters for 18 years.

Ms. Henning serves as a Board Member and VP of the Minnesota Chapter of the German American Chamber of Commerce of the Midwest (GACC-Midwest) and as a Leadership Committee Member of the Florida Chapter of the German American Chamber of the Southern United States (GACC-South) as well as the French American Chamber of Commerce in Minnesota.

His reputation as a skilled and dependable advocate has earned him the distinction of Minnesota Super Lawyers Rising Star in Construction Litigation since 2022.

Alex has a history of success representing clients in various industries, including construction, real estate, finance, insurance, hospitality, telecom, sports, and retail.

Alex is committed to understanding his clients and their goals. He approaches each case with his client’s unique needs in mind, employing his knowledge and creativity to develop pragmatic solutions and innovative strategies to meet the client’s objectives.

Alex earned his J.D. in 2016 from the University of Minnesota Law School, where he was Captain and Vice President of the Fighting Mondales ice hockey team, an editor of the Minnesota Law Review, and the winner of the “best brief” award in his legal writing class. He received a B.A. in political science from the State University of New York at Buffalo in 2012.

A lifelong hockey player, Alex officiates youth ice hockey in Minnesota District 3. He also enjoys improv comedy, live theater, film, and Buffalo Bills football.

attorneys.name: Michael W. Hero
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Estate Lawyers in Northfield, MN
attorneys.bio:
Michael W. Hero is a Northfield native and 1968 graduate of Northfield High School. In 1972 he graduated from Gustavus Adolphus College with a B.A. degree. Prior to practicing law, he worked extensively in the construction field in Minneapolis and along the Canadian border in Minnesota. He graduated with the degree of Juris Doctor magna cum laude from William Mitchell College of Law in 1983.

After law school he held attorney positions with several law firms and companies before starting his own law practice in Northfield in 1988 known as Hero Law Office. He expanded the law practice to include a title company known as Hero Abstract and Title Company in 1994. While in private practice in Northfield he represented hundreds of small businesses, thousands of individuals, and several banks, litigated and tried numerous civil lawsuits, and closed thousands of real estate transactions.

In 2006 he scaled down his practice and began working in an “Of Counsel” position for a Northfield law firm and a second law firm in Grand Marais, Minnesota. Mike served as a director and corporate secretary of Heywood Bancshares, Inc., a bank holding company, and served as Executive Vice President and General Counsel for the First National Bank of Northfield until the bank was sold in 2019 and the holding company was dissolved in 2020.

Mike is a past trustee and president of Laura Baker Services Association, an organization located in Northfield dedicated to the care and assistance of people with developmental disabilities.

He is an avid fly fisher, fly tyer, canoer, and traveler.

His areas of practice are: Business Law, Estate Planning, Real Estate, Probate, and Civil Litigation.

Honors

American Jurisprudence Awards (3) Insurance, Trusts & Family Law

West Publishing Hornbook Award for Scholastic Excellence

Member, Guild of St. Ansgar

attorneys.bio:
Joel Hilgendorf is an attorney with Hellmuth & Johnson, PLLC, in both the Real Estate and Community Association Practice Groups. Joel's clients include banks, developers, commercial and residential property owners, condominium and townhome associations, and businesses and individuals.

Joel's practice includes counsel and representation in the following primary areas:

Real estate law and litigation

Community Association law

Foreclosure law and Creditor's remedies

Commercial and residential real estate transactions

Joel is dedicated to providing clients with exceptional service - defining his practice through efficiency, attention to detail and a commitment to excellence.

Joel has been certified by the Minnesota State Bar Association as a Board Certified Real Property Specialist, a designation held by a select few Minnesota attorneys. Joel is experienced in:

Commercial and residential real estate transactions and disputes

Landlord/tenant issues

Clearing Title Defects

Creditor's Remedies and Collections

Boundary Disputes

Easements

Contracts for Deed and Cancellations

Mortgages and Foreclosure Law

Priority Disputes

Partition Actions

Quiet Title Actions/Torrens Actions

Zoning and Land Use

Condemnation

One of Joel's particular areas of concentration is representing condominium and townhome associations. He is active in the Minnesota Chapter of the Community Associations Institute, where has served on the Board of Directors. Joel has extensive experience representing community associations in all of their legal needs, including:

Assessment collection and lien foreclosure

Covenant enforcement

Interpreting and Amending governing documents

Drafting and reviewing contracts

Construction defects

Fair Housing matters

Joel is a frequent speaker and presenter on real estate law issues. Joel also routinely authors articles for real estate industry publications and trade journals.

He has been named to the Minnesota Rising StarsSM list 4 times (2008, 2010, 2011 & 2012) Only 2.5% of young attorneys in the state are chosen each year.

Joel is licensed to practice law in the state and federal courts in Minnesota, and is a member of the Real Property Sections of both the Hennepin County Bar Association and Minnesota State Bar Associations. He obtained his law degree from the University of Minnesota Law School, and completed his undergraduate studies at the University of Illinois, Urbana.

attorneys.name: Stephanie J. Hill Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Edina, MN
attorneys.bio:
Stephanie J. Hill grew up in small town Detroit Lakes, MN. After graduating high school, Stephanie went on to obtain her Bachelors Degree in American Law and Legal Systems from Hamline University in St. Paul, MN and later her law degree from the University of St. Thomas School of Law in Minneapolis, MN.

Prior to attending law school, Stephanie was introduced to the family court system as a responding party in a family law matter. After nearly two years of litigation, five days of trial and $50,000+ in legal fees, Stephanie prevailed. Stephanie became an attorney to help others faced with divorce and related family law issues. No one understands the stakes better than someone who has been in your very same shoes, and knows first-hand what you stand to lose. Stephanie will approach your case with a fierce advocacy and compassionate understanding.

Stephanie focuses her practice exclusively in the area of family law, with a special emphasis on cases involving members of the military and law enforcement.

attorneys.name: George Hiller
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
George Hiller is an experienced employment law attorney who represents both employers and employees in a wide range of complex and sensitive workplace matters. His practice includes pre-litigation and litigation work, internal investigations, policy development, and preventative employer training. Known for his balanced and pragmatic approach, George helps clients navigate issues such as discrimination, harassment, wage and hour disputes, and contract matters. He regularly conducts training and continuing legal education seminars on compliance and best practices in the field of employment law. Committed to resolving conflicts efficiently and effectively, he is a trusted advisor to employer and employee clients seeking creative and strategic solutions to difficult workplace challenges.

George is a graduate of the Stetson University College of Law, where he interned with the Civil and Appellate Divisions of the United States Attorney's Office for the Middle District of Florida which provided him with extensive exposure to federal litigation in a number of different practice areas. George was an involved Stetson Dispute Resolution/Negotiation Team member and the first-place finisher in William & Mary's 2018 National Invitational Negotiation Tournament. He also served as a teaching fellow for both Federal Civil Procedure and Federal Pre-Trial Practice. George is a recipient of Stetson's Certificate of Concentration in Advocacy. George received his undergraduate degree in Entrepreneurship from Florida State University.

George holds bar licenses in Minnesota and Florida.

attorneys.name: Sharon K. Hills
attorneys.firm_name: Dougherty, Molenda, Solfest, Hills & Bauer P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Apple Valley, MN
attorneys.bio:
Sharon K. Hills is a shareholder with Dougherty, Molenda, Solfest, Hills & Bauer P.A. Sharon has been with the firm for over 30 years, practicing primarily in the area of family law. Sharon handles various types of family law matters, including divorce, custody, child support, spousal maintenance, modification of custody, support and maintenance matters, and prenuptial agreements. Sharon has also represented numerous clients in cases involving division of property interests between cohabitating partners. During her many years with the firm, Sharon has successfully argued and defended many cases before the Minnesota Court of Appeals and the Minnesota Supreme Court. Sharon is a leading family law attorney in Dakota County and has been named to the Super Lawyers® list by her peers in the Minnesota bar annually since 2014.

In addition to her family law practice, Sharon practices regularly in the area of municipal law, providing representation to the Cities of Apple Valley and Eagan. This representation involves land use issues, city code enforcement and violation prosecution, and city ordinance enforcement and drafting.

When not practicing law and representing her clients, Sharon enjoys gardening, fly fishing and hunting for Lake Superior agates.

attorneys.name: Jared Hines
attorneys.practice_type: Family Lawyers in Rochester, MN
attorneys.bio:
Jared is an associate at Klampe Law Firm and joined the firm in 2021. He graduated law school in 2013 and is licensed in both Minnesota and North Dakota. Jared has a wide variety of experience with different types of legal issues, but focuses primarily on civil litigation, with an emphasis in family law and personal injury.

Jared attended law school in Grand Forks, North Dakota. Among other accolades, he was president of the school's Criminal Law Association and earned the highest marks of his entire class in a course called International Business Transactions. He excelled in moot court opportunities and spent a considerable amount of his time in law school interning various county attorney's offices. Jared is an experienced and zealous advocate for his clients in any courtroom setting.

Following law school, Jared was selected as a judicial law clerk in North Dakota's East Central Judicial District, based in Fargo, where he spent his time gaining courtroom experience, building relationships with judges and court staff, and drafting orders. Jared was since an Assistant City Attorney in Fargo, North Dakota, where he prosecuted municipal crimes, and spent more than six years with a private general practice firm where he handled all of the firm's family law, including divorce, custody, child support, parenting time, adoptions, restraining orders, and civil commitments, as well as a portion of the firm's business dispute and personal injury claims.

Jared relocated to southern Minnesota in 2021 to spend more time with his family. In his free time, Jared enjoys following the Vikings and Twins, biking, golfing, and hiking with his golden retriever.

Areas Of Practice

Family Law

Personal Injury

General Civil Litigation

Criminal Defense

attorneys.name: Kevin D. Hofman
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
I usually get called to the table when you're in crisis. But I bring more than just courtroom savvy to your team. I offer an earnest resolve to take your issue to completion, in the best way for you. Your dispute is important to you so it is important to me. And while I'll be a tireless advocate for you, my other strength is separating emotions from the issue at hand. So you get a practical solution that works for your business. After all, litigation is costly and time-intensive, so your efforts are better spent elsewhere. People I work with say that I am: Efficient - My work is purposeful and I don't waste my time, or your time. I'm prepared, always. Honest - I tell you exactly what I think even if it's not what you want to hear. Social - I don't take life too seriously and know how to have a good time. It's not uncommon to see me out with friends, many of them clients, enjoying their company.

attorneys.name: Phaedra J. Howard
attorneys.practice_type: Collections, Creditor Remedies & Bankruptcy Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Phaedra Howard is an attorney with the firm and a member of the Real Estate and Development Practice Group, where she serves both individuals and a broad range of entities, including condominium, townhouse, cooperative and other community associations.

Phaedra concentrates her practice in the following areas:

Real Estate Law

Collections, creditor's rights and remedies, including creditor bankruptcy representation

Community association law

Phaedra assists community associations in:

Collection of assessments, including lien foreclosure

Enforcement of governing documents

Drafting and amending governing documents

Homeowner and vendor disputes

Reviewing and negotiating management agreements and vendor contracts

Providing advice/legal opinions on a wide variety of issues affecting associations

Real estate law services include:

Mortgage and lien enforcement/foreclosure

Mechanic's liens

Contracts for deed and cancellations

Purchase agreements, sales and leases of residential and commercial real estate

Easements

Landlord/tenant disputes, including evictions

Quieting title defects

Adverse possession and boundary disputes

Title exams and opinions

Torrens registration and proceedings subsequent

Real estate litigation and appeals

Phaedra strives to meet and exceed her clients' expectations by providing personalized service and sound and practical legal advice and direction. Her knowledge and years of experience in the areas of real estate, community association law and collections/creditor remedies and representation provide her with the ability to anticipate and respond to her clients' various needs in a thorough and efficient manner.

Licensed to practice law in the state courts of Minnesota and Wisconsin and the federal court in Minnesota, Phaedra is a member of the Hennepin County and Minnesota State Bar Associations, the Wisconsin Bar Association, and the American Bar Association. She is also a member of the Minnesota Chapter of the Community Associations Institute, the Minnesota Multi-Housing Association and Professional Women in Real Estate. Phaedra is a frequent contributor to industry publications and has presented lectures on various legal topics involving associations.

She joined Hellmuth & Johnson in 2008. Phaedra obtained her J.D. from the Hamline University School of Law, and completed her undergraduate studies at the University of Chicago, where she obtained a B.A. in cultural anthropology.

attorneys.name: Sara Hunemiller
attorneys.firm_name: Dougherty, Molenda, Solfest, Hills & Bauer P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Apple Valley, MN
attorneys.bio:
Sara Hunemiller brings a compassionate and client-centered approach to her work as a Family Law attorney. Admitted to practice in Minnesota and Missouri, Sara is dedicated to helping families navigate complex and emotional legal issues with empathy and professionalism.

Sara earned her Juris Doctor from the University of St. Thomas School of Law, where she gained practical experience through the Community Justice Project Legal Clinic and clerkships focusing on family law. Her work included drafting pleadings, conducting discovery, preparing clients and witnesses for hearings, and advocating for domestic violence survivors.

Sara received a 2021 Mission Award from St. Thomas Law—specifically, the Scholarly Engagement and Societal Reform Award—for her research and advocacy efforts on “Knock First MN,” which focused on no-knock warrant reform. At her commencement, she was also recognized for completing 199 hours of public service, reflecting her deep commitment to making a positive impact on families and communities.

Before joining the firm, Sara worked as a Family Law Clerk at prominent firms in Los Angeles and Minnesota. She developed her skills by managing case calendars, preparing trial materials, and facilitating sensitive client interactions. Sara's background also includes legislative research and advocacy, reflecting her passion for improving legal systems that impact families.

Sara holds a Bachelor’s degree in Communication Studies with a minor in Psychology from Iowa State University. Her unique academic and professional journey equips her to provide thoughtful and strategic counsel to clients during challenging times.

attorneys.name: Scott G. Husaby
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
A shareholder at Monroe Moxness Berg PA, Scott represents closely held businesses and individuals in the areas of estate planning and wealth preservation including:

Wills and trusts

Retirement planning

Asset protection planning

Business succession

Employee incentive programs

Exit planning

He also assists clients with tax planning, general corporate law, and tax controversy resolution.

A leader in the firm's Multi-Unit Succession and Transition (MUST) group, Scott works with multi-unit retail business owners helping them solve the unique legal challenges to structuring their exit plan. The process combines Scott's skills and experience with the firm's strengths in the areas of taxation, estate planning, corporate finance, franchise and mergers and acquisitions to provide a targeted and effective exit plan.

Prior to joining the firm, Scott focused on transactions and tax planning for businesses and individuals as a tax specialist for the international accounting firm of PricewaterhouseCoopers. Scott then served as assistant tax counsel for Wells Fargo where he performed federal tax planning and was involved in the resolution of tax controversies.

Scott contributes to franchise industry publications and has been honored by Franchise Times as one of franchising's "Legal Eagles." He has been named a "FIVE STAR: Best in Client Satisfaction Wealth Manager" by MplsSt.Paul Magazine and Twin Cities Business Monthly. In addition, Scott has been recognized in The Best Lawyers in America® for tax law and was listed in "Who's Who in Trust/Estate Planning Law" by Minnesota Law & Politics magazine.

Graduating with a B.A. degree from St. Olaf College, Scott earned his Juris Doctor degree, cum laude, at William Mitchell College of Law.

attorneys.practice_type: Child Support Lawyers in Maplewood, MN
attorneys.bio:
Christina Huson has devoted her career to helping families through the difficult process of dissolving a marriage. As a mother, she understands the extraordinary difficulties a parent is capable of enduring for a child's benefit. She also knows that children prosper most when both parents share an active and constructive role in their lives. For more than 30 years, Ms. Huson has focused on helping people emerge from complicated and emotionally charged episodes into stable and fulfilling new lives that have retained the good things they've worked for and care about deeply.

Christina grew up in Grand Rapids, Minnesota, and still handles a number of cases in that area as well as in the Twin Cities.

attorneys.name: Ross M. Hussey
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Bloomington, MN
attorneys.bio:
Ross’s practice areas include insurance coverage disputes, construction defect litigation, corporate litigation, community association law, and general corporate representation.

Ross has a unique background. Prior to joining Smith Jadin Johnson, Ross spent over three years specializing in construction litigation where he primary handled large and complex construction defect cases on behalf of property owners and associations. In many of these cases, Ross would represent his clients against a national companies. Despite constantly being outnumbered in the courtroom, Ross has had tremendous success, including securing seven figure settlements for his clients and winning at jury trial.

Ross also has a business and entrepreneurial side. He is a co-founder and former general counsel of Minnesota Medical Solutions, one of the two medical cannabis companies to be awarded a license to produce and distribute cannabis to medical patients in the state of Minnesota. The work involved with obtaining the Minnesota license and launching the company was extensive and included corporate structuring, fundraising, government relations, media relations, real estate transactions, union relations and employment matters.

Throughout his career Ross has also handled many different legal matters, which include business disputes, business transactions, civil rights litigation, criminal cases and employment disputes. Ross has represented clients in state court, federal court and at the appellate level.

In his free time, Ross enjoys spending time with his wife and two very active young boys. He also enjoys playing hockey, skiing and going through the constant emotional turmoil of being a Vikings fan.

attorneys.name: Erin Hutchinson
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Lawyers in Minneapolis, MN
attorneys.bio:
Erin is an experienced commercial attorney who joined Rock Hutchinson as a partner in 2016. She offers a broad range of services to clients of all sizes but focuses her practice on serving as outside general counsel to major food brands. She also dedicates a significant portion of her time to long-term roles working with the in-house law departments of well-known food, beverage and consumer good organizations.

Erin started her practice in the commercial litigation group at Oppenheimer Wolff & Donnelly LLP (now Fox Rothschild LLP). She left private practice to join General Mills where she served as a member of its business unit leadership teams and handled a wide range of legal matters.

Erin's experiences includes general counseling, trade and price management, litigation oversight, food law and labeling, issues management, M&A planning and integration, marketing and advertising review, negotiating and drafting supply and sale-side contracts, brokerage agreements, distribution agreements, sweepstakes, joint development agreements, and research agreements. She also offers antitrust compliance training.

Erin's current practice is mostly comprised of long-term roles where she serves as the outside general counsel to operating companies or in other ongoing positions where she works on an integrated basis with her clients' business teams and/or legal departments.

Contact Erin by emailing her at ehutchinson@rockhutchinson.com or by calling her at (612) 599-8142.

attorneys.name: Finn S. Jacobsen
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Bloomington, MN
attorneys.bio:
"My clients deserve someone who can explain things to them in an easy to understand and straightforward manner, provide realistic expectations, and then advocate aggressively on their behalf. My goal is to provide exactly that to each and every client."

Finn has successfully advocated for his clients in all areas involving community associations, including the retrieval of assessments through collections and foreclosures; enforcement of association rules and governing documents; mediation, arbitration, and litigation; interpretation and amendment of governing documents; and many others. Finn’s successful results in his practice allows him to approach his clients’ problems with a keen understanding and familiarity of the issues related to community associations.

Finn plays an essential role in providing legal counseling to associations. Whether a community is self-managed or employs a professional property management company, Finn prides himself in his commitment to prompt, personal service. He has provided legal counsel to associations relating to municipal law, state law, federal law, and administrative hearing.

He practices in the following areas:

Community Association Law

Insurance Appraisals and Litigation

Construction Law and Litigation

attorneys.name: David W. Jacobsen
attorneys.practice_type: Estate & Trusts Lawyers in Northfield, MN
attorneys.bio:
David truly enjoys the relationship he has with his valued clients. David has had the privilege of representing countless clients with a variety of legal matters over the last 10+ years. He is uniquely skilled to competently advise clients with complex transactional matters but also represent the same clients in arguments before the court.

His diverse experience includes handling hundreds of real estate transactions, forming many business entities, assisting clients with the purchase and sale of businesses (M&A), drafting hundreds of estate plans, guiding fiduciaries through about a hundred probates and trust administrations, defending hundreds of clients charged with crimes from violent felonies to speeding tickets, arguing pre-trial and post-trial motions, conducting contested hearings, and trying civil and criminal cases to both judges and juries.

Background

Born and raised in Southern Minnesota, David W. Jacobsen is a proud graduate of Kenyon-Wanamingo High School, the University of Minnesota, and William Mitchell College of Law. While attending law school, he worked as a law clerk for a small private tribal law firm and worked as a student certified attorney for the Minneapolis City Attorney's Office. After law school, David returned to his hometown of Kenyon and founded his own law practice. After a few years as a solo, David joined up with attorneys Mike Hero and Steve Jorstad to opened Hero, Jorstad, & Jacobsen Law Firm, P.A. The firm was renamed Jacobsen Law Firm, P.A. in 2020.

Personal

David and his wife Mariah are active members of the Northfield community serving on a number of boards for non-profit organizations. They have three (3) children - Rory (6), and twins Reese (4) and Quinn (4). Outside of the office, David coaches youth baseball and basketball and is an avid fan of Minnesota Golden Gophers football. Ski-u-mah! Row the Boat! Go Gophers! He enjoys spending time with his wife and kids, golfing, camping, fishing, and traveling.
